answer: Blood donation attestation stops fake identities at the clinic. A newcomer shows a donation record from the last 90 days, and the blood bank confirms the donor ID and blood type against its registry. A record tied to another identity is rejected, and members must donate each quarter. One honest donor spends $25 and 45 minutes, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 visits and $25,000, since one body can donate at most six times a year. Vertex certifies the visit, Meadow holds the registry, Grove keeps donors honest.
